measurements.notes: HONEST COST INVERSION: the window screenshot (336x541 px = 243 tok) is 2.7x CHEAPER than the structured view (666 tok) — a small, control-dense panel is the native mirror of the Hacker News result: structured cost scales with information density, screenshot cost with area. Structure still wins on diffs (266-736 B/interaction vs 243 tok/re-shot) and idle (0). ROUND-1 INCIDENT (recorded, not hidden): (1) SetForegroundWindow was silently denied by the Windows foreground lock -> Calculator stayed behind Notepad -> 3 blind clicks landed in the user's Notepad text area (caret move only, document verified unmodified; screenshot artifacts that accidentally captured the user's file content were purged). (2) The first hit-test guard compared PIDs and FALSE-BLOCKED because of the UWP frame(ApplicationFrameHost)/content(CalculatorApp) process split — the working guard compares the top-level window handle of ControlFromPoint(x,y). Both are router lessons: verify foreground after asking for it, and guard every blind click with a system-wide hit-test (Windows analog of the macOS AXUIElementCopyElementAtPosition mitigation).
